validation.rootTestsNote: Isolated host-root run: DSH_CONTROLS_HOST_ROOT plus the checksum-bound accepted tarball, so no environment-gated host integration case was skipped. A plain node --test without that host seam reports 760 cases with 286 environment-gated skips.
validation.featureEvidence: A frozen storage snapshot is reused while its stored revision is unchanged, so repeated instrument polling no longer re-parses, re-clones and re-freezes whole versioned documents; the store is still consulted and CAS advances the revision, which invalidates the retained snapshot. Combined with the 0.4.7 header-only session facts, idle CPU no longer decodes stored session logs or repeatedly rebuilds storage documents.
